checks.name: Draft-only state
checks.rule: document_status is ai_draft and output contains no approval or durable-memory state.

checks.name: Resolvable segment
checks.rule: Every clinical item references a segment present in its source transcript.

checks.name: Exact source quote
checks.rule: Each source_quote is an exact substring of its referenced transcript segment.

checks.name: Speaker attribution
checks.rule: evidence.speaker matches the transcript segment speaker; doctor-only sections remain doctor-attributed.

checks.name: Negation preserved
checks.rule: Absent symptoms or actions are not converted into positive findings.

checks.name: Temporality preserved
checks.rule: Current, prior, planned, and patient-reported historical events remain distinct.

checks.name: Medication identity
checks.rule: Drug name is exact as spoken; unclear identity is not normalized.

checks.name: Dose and strength
checks.rule: Dose, strength, and units match evidence or remain explicitly uncertain.

checks.name: Frequency and timing
checks.rule: Frequency, meal timing, and time of day match the source.

checks.name: Medication action
checks.rule: Started, continued, increased, decreased, held, or stopped is emitted only when explicitly supported with correct context.

checks.name: Investigation values
checks.rule: Test name, numeric value, unit, review/request state, and date context match evidence.

checks.name: Required-fact recall
checks.rule: Every fact classified as required for the case is present.

checks.name: Forbidden and unsupported facts
checks.rule: No forbidden fact, unsupported diagnosis, causal claim, treatment suggestion, or invented detail appears.

checks.name: Uncertainty containment
checks.rule: Ambiguous high-risk content is routed to uncertain_items with an appropriate blocking flag.
